title: feat(components): the record chrome draws the record's picture from the object's `imageField` (objectui#11383)
body:
Fixes #11383

Clause-②: no

The record chrome (`page:header`'s record chip) now draws the record's picture beside the title, from the field the object names in its object-level `imageField` (`@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0, objectstack-ai/objectstack#21182). This is the renderer half of ruling A on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1199.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL` (dispatched os-dev run for the `domain:ui` seat 1 claim on this card).

## What changed

- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, the record branch of `PageHeaderRenderer`: reads `objectSchema.imageField`, takes the served row's value for that field, and passes the picture to the existing `icon` slot of `RecordTitleChip`. Nothing else in the header moves.
- The picture is a Radix `Avatar` + `AvatarImage` with **no** `AvatarFallback`. It renders only once the image has loaded, so there is no initials or placeholder avatar, and a URL that fails to load leaves no broken-image icon.
- An `avatar` field is drawn round and cropped (`rounded-full`, `object-cover`). An `image` field, such as a logo, is drawn whole in a rounded square (`rounded-md`, `object-contain`). Both are 32px.
- Nothing is drawn, and the header is byte-identical to the undeclared header, when:
  - the object declares no `imageField`;
  - the value is empty (`null`, `''`, `[]`, or an object with no `url`);
  - the field is absent from the row, which is how a field the reader may not see arrives. Masking stays the server's answer and is not decided again here.
- `recordChrome: false` keeps the bare header, picture or not. The record branch is skipped, as it was before.
- The object declaration is the only channel. No `page:header` prop is read, and no field is read by a conventional name (`logo`, `avatar`, `image`, …).
- Changeset: `.changeset/11383-record-chrome-image.md`, `@object-ui/components` minor (a new user-visible capability).

No `@object-ui/*` export, prop, type member or i18n key is added. The `icon` slot of `RecordTitleChip` already exists, and the object schema is read untyped, as the title rungs already read it.

## Measured premises (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

1. **The spec judges `imageField` at parse.** Measured on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 `data.ObjectSchema.safeParse`. It accepts `imageField: 'logo'` naming an `image` field and naming an `avatar` field. It refuses an undeclared name (`declares no field`) and a `text` or `file` field (`which is not a picture`). A bogus sibling key `imageFieldBogus` is refused as unrecognized, which is the control. So the renderer does not check the field's type again.
2. **The record branch has both inputs.** `ctx.objectSchema` and `ctx.data` are both in hand where the title is resolved from `nameField`. The console's record page (`RecordDetailView`) fetches the row with `findOne` and no `$select`, with `$expand` on relations only, so the picture field arrives with the row.
3. **The served value's shape.** The spec's read form for `image` / `avatar` is `valueSchemaFor(def, 'expanded')`: a bare `sys_file` id or `FileValueSchema` (`{ url, name?, size?, mimeType?, alt? }`, where `url` is required), and an array when `multiple`. The server's `resolveFileReferences` (objectql engine) hydrates a stored id into `{ id, name, size, mimeType, url }`. It passes a URL string or an inline blob through unchanged, and leaves a bare id when the `sys_file` lookup fails or the id matches no committed row.
   - objectui already resolves those forms in one place: `readFileValue` / `readFileValues` in `@object-ui/fields` (its file-value module), which `ImageCellRenderer` draws.
   - **It cannot be imported here.** `@object-ui/fields` depends on `@object-ui/components`, so importing it from components closes a package cycle. Moving it down into `@object-ui/core` adds core exports, which the `Clause-②: no` fence forbids.
   - So the header carries a small private resolver, `recordPictureUrl`, for exactly the spec's read forms. An expanded object gives its `url`. A bare id (judged by the spec's own `isFileIdToken`, imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`) gives the stable download path `/api/v1/storage/files/ID`. A URL string is drawn as it is. For a list, the first entry that resolves is drawn.
   - It deliberately does **not** take `readFileValue`'s id-only-object arm: an object without `url` is not a read form the spec admits.
   - The function's comment states that it is a second resolution. The test-only parity pin `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.recordChromeParity-11383.test.tsx` keeps the two together (seat ruling `5981856796` on the card, option C); see Tests.
4. Not this PR: the objectstack liveness row `object.imageField` flips at objectstack's `.objectui-sha` pin bump.

**One deviation from the suggested route.** The picture's accessible name is **not** the record title. The chip's `icon` slot is `aria-hidden`, and the H1 directly beside the picture already names the record, so the picture is decorative and its `alt` is empty. Naming it with the title would read the same name twice.

## Tests

New pin: `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-record-picture-11383.test.tsx`, 13 cases, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry inside a `RecordContext`:

- The expanded `{ url }` value is drawn in the title row, ahead of the H1, decorative (`alt=""`, inside `aria-hidden`).
- A bare `sys_file` id is drawn from the stable download path.
- A URL string is drawn as it is.
- For a `multiple` list, the first drawable entry is drawn, and only one image.
- An `image` field is drawn as a rounded square with `object-contain`; an `avatar` field is drawn round with `object-cover`.
- Without `imageField`, a row carrying `logo` / `avatar` / `image` draws nothing.
- Nothing is drawn for a value that is absent from the row, `null`, `''`, `[]`, or an object with no `url`. Each case's header markup equals the undeclared header's markup.
- A picture that has not loaded draws no `img`. This case uses the real `window.Image`; the other cases use the `LoadedImage` stand-in from the `@object-ui/fields` avatar tests.
- `recordChrome: false` gives a header whose markup equals the undeclared one.

Ablations, each run on the committed fix through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation was proven on disk (anchor count 1 → 0, blob changed). Each restore was proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **Deleting `icon={recordPicture}`**: 6 failed | 7 passed. Every case that draws a picture went red. The 7 that stayed green are the "nothing is drawn" controls, as expected.
- **Adding a conventional fallback `objSchema?.imageField ?? 'logo'`**: 1 failed. The "logo / avatar / image keys" control went red.
- **Drawing the wrapper whenever `imageField` is declared** (`pictureFieldName ? (` in place of `pictureUrl ? (`): 5 failed. All five empty-value controls went red, so "nothing" cannot hide an empty wrapper.

**Parity pin (patch round 1, `e2df897`):** `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.recordChromeParity-11383.test.tsx`, 19 cases (11 drawn, 7 empty, 1 divergence). It renders `page:header` through the real `SchemaRenderer` over every read form the header admits and asserts that the drawn `src` equals the URL the image cell draws, or that neither side draws. The id-only object is asserted as an explicit divergence: fields resolves it, the header draws nothing. Ablation on committed code, `RECORD_PICTURE_FILE_PATH` `/api/v1/…` → `/api/v2/…`: 3 failed | 16 passed (exactly the three bare-id cases); restored blob == HEAD. Patch round 2 (`1a13128`) is comment-only: the `recordPictureUrl` docblock now names this pin.

| the same set on the merged head as `--shard=1/2` + `--shard=2/2` (180 + 179 files, 1754 + 1889 tests passed) | `4a34ea4` | 0 / 0 |
| `pnpm --filter "@object-ui/components^..." build` then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` (both `tsc` passes; `--listFiles` confirms both the new test and `containers.tsx` are compiled) | `4a34ea4` | 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components lint` (0 errors; no warning on a changed line) | `4a34ea4` | 0 |
| `check:new-line-citations` · `check:control-bytes` · `check:phantom-deps` | `711adb9` | 0 |
| `check:changeset-claims` · `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:unreferenced-sources` · `check:test-path-roots` · `check-changeset-no-major` · `check-changeset-presence` | `4a34ea4` | 0 |

The package's script is spelled `type-check` (with a hyphen); a `typecheck` filter matches no script.

NOT MEASURED locally: `check:spec-floors` and `check:eager-closure`. The first reads every released package's built `dist/`, and the second reads the console's production build. This run built neither. The fact the floor gate asks about was read directly instead: `isFileIdToken` is exported from `@objectstack/spec/data` at `17.0.0` (both `dist/data/index.d.ts` and `index.mjs` of the npm tarball), which is `@object-ui/components`' declared floor. `@object-ui/core` already imports `@objectstack/spec/data` at runtime, so that module was already in the package's closure.

## Acceptance notes

- **Docs (done in patch round 1).** `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx`: the record-chip bullet now names the record's picture, shown beside the heading when the object names an `imageField` and the record's value for it is not empty.
- **The record side panel.** `RecordDetailPanel` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) draws its own `DetailView` heading, not `page:header`, so it shows no picture. The card scopes the change to `page:header`; this is noted, not changed.
- **The objectstack describe.** The `imageField` describe in `@objectstack/spec` still reads "Pending renderer: the record chrome does not draw it yet." That text belongs to objectstack, and it moves with the liveness row at the pin bump.
